blind_intent: The analyzer must report diagnostics for types marked SuppressSourceGeneration = true. It must not stop reporting diagnostics for these types.

behavior_changes.title: MessagePack.SourceGenerator no longer crashes on duplicate or mixed keys
behavior_changes.link_why: The requirement concerns the reporting of diagnostics for suppressed types, not generator crashes on duplicate keys.

question.prompt: What happens when the source generator processes this class after the PR?

options.text: It generates a formatter that includes both members
It generates a formatter for the first member only

question.reveal_text: The ledger shows the generator crashed on base but now passes tests verifying it serializes only the first member when keys are duplicated.

behavior_changes.title: MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer no longer crashes and reports diagnostics on duplicate or mixed keys
behavior_changes.link_why: While these tests use SuppressSourceGeneration = true, the requirement is about a specific regression (v3.1.0 -> v3.1.1) which Git Facts prove is not in this history.

question.prompt: What is the result of running the analyzer on this code after the PR?
question.reveal_text: The ledger shows the analyzer crashed on base but now passes tests verifying that duplicate keys are reported as diagnostics.

refusals.topic: Whether the reported regression (v3.1.0 -> v3.1.1) is fixed
refusals.why: Git Facts explicitly state that the reported regression and the commits between the affected versions are not in the history of the base commit; therefore, this PR cannot be fixing the reported cause.

story_claims.quote: Verifies that the analyzer keeps validating [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] types
story_claims.claim: The analyzer should continue to validate types even when source generation is suppressed because they are still serialized at run time.
story_claims.why: The placebo test proves that a member without a key is still reported as a diagnostic for a suppressed type.

not_checked: Whether the addition of 'continue' in TypeCollector.cs suppresses other intended diagnostics when keys are mixed.
Whether the use of ContainsKey before Add in TypeCollector.cs impacts performance for very large types.
_about: Reviewer spec written by a model (B2). Inputs: requirement + diff of human-lane files + executed ledger; never PR text, commit messages or docs. Claims only: `et record --spec ai` checks every cited test against the ledger and downgrades mismatches to hearsay.
